remarks: Beautifully Renovated Home in Prime Norwalk Location.  Welcome to 185 Newtown Avenue, a stunningly renovated home that perfectly blends modern updates with timeless charm. Located in the heart of Norwalk's desirable Cranbury neighborhood and wood pond area.  This move-in ready residence offers comfort, style, and convenience. Step inside to discover a bright, open floor plan featuring gleaming hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and freshly painted interiors. The brand-new kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a stylish tile backsplash. The spacious living and dining areas are ideal for entertaining, while the oversized windows fill the home with natural light. Upstairs, you'll find well-appointed bedrooms with ample closet space, along with updated bathrooms showcasing designer finishes and spa-like details.  Additional highlights include a peaceful and serene waterfront view, a lower level with two bedrooms, or can be used as a flexible space for an office, gym, or playroom. Private backyard perfect for gatherings or relaxing, ample parking and storage, and perfectly situated near schools, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes. This home offers both convenience and lifestyle. Don't miss the opportunity to own this beautifully renovated Norwalk gem. Schedule your private showing today!
